@licstart/@licend, classic GPLv2-or-later prose (known false-positive regression case)

Correct popup result: GPL-2.0-or-later. This is the single most common verbatim "free software... version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" notice in existence, including the old FSF postal address boilerplate ("... Boston, MA 02110-1301, USA").

This is a known regression case for NAME_TO_SPDX's /gnu general public license.*v?3/ pattern in license-db.js: its unbounded .* can greedily reach the stray "3" digit inside "02110-1301" and misclassify this as GPL-3.0-or-later instead — see the conversation history for the audit that found this. Kept here specifically so a future fix to that pattern can be verified against a real, common notice rather than a synthetic one.
